{{Top|leg}}
"'''Go Aboard the Bongo'''" was an article by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. In it, he described the [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|Gungan bongo]] he, [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] used to travel to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Behind the scenes==
This article was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]]. It appeared in the [[1999]] edition of [[Star Wars Kids (1999) 6|''Star Wars Kids'' 6]].
